user.title: Energy Sharing setup
user.description: Configure energy sharing settlement from cumulative energy counters. The integration creates aligned 15-minute intervals internally. Select receiver total grid import, total received shared energy, and at least one of fixed allocation percentage or provider total grid export.

data_description.receiver_import_total_source: Cumulative energy sensor for total grid import at the receiver (Prejemnik), in Wh or kWh.
data_description.shared_energy_total_source: Cumulative energy sensor for total energy allocated to the receiver (Prejemnik) through energy sharing.
data_description.provider_export_total_source: Optional cumulative energy sensor for total grid export at the provider (Oddajnik).
data_description.fixed_allocation_percentage: Fixed contractual allocation percentage. Required when provider export is not configured.

error.duplicate_sources: Each selected source entity must be unique.
error.source_missing: The selected entity does not exist.
error.source_not_numeric: The selected entity state is not a valid non-negative number.
error.unsupported_energy_unit: The selected entity uses an unsupported energy unit. Use Wh or kWh.
error.percentage_invalid: The allocation percentage must be greater than zero and at most 100.
error.percentage_or_export_required: Configure a fixed allocation percentage and/or a provider total grid export source.

abort.already_configured: This receiver import and shared energy pair is already configured.

init.title: Energy Sharing options
init.description: Immutable sources: receiver import `{receiver_import_total_source}`, shared energy `{shared_energy_total_source}`. Update percentage, provider export, timing, and reconciliation here.

active_load_sensors.title: Select active load power sensors
active_load_sensors.description: Select a real-time power sensor for each switch.

error.percentage_invalid: The allocation percentage must be greater than zero and at most 100.
error.percentage_or_export_required: Configure a fixed allocation percentage and/or a provider total grid export source.

options.reconciliation_mode_warn: Warn and process with actual shared energy

process_now.name: Process now
process_now.description: Attempt to process the latest eligible completed interval.

reset_totals.name: Reset totals
reset_totals.description: Reset integration-owned cumulative totals and counters. Source cumulative sensors are not changed.

confirm.name: Confirm reset
confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm resetting cumulative totals.

reinitialize_baseline.name: Reinitialize baseline
reinitialize_baseline.description: Record current cumulative source totals as a fresh baseline without resetting integration-owned totals.
